mapper.sql: mission_id, verse_no, tier, scope, site_id, variant_no, body, origin_ref, review_status
( (m.scope = 'SITE' AND m.site_id = #{siteId}) OR (m.scope = 'VERSE' AND m.verse_no = #{verseNo}) OR (m.scope = 'COMMON') )
mapper.select: SELECT m.scope AS scope, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM mission m WHERE m.tier = #{tier} AND AND GROUP BY m.scope
SELECT FROM mission m WHERE m.tier = #{tier} AND m.scope = #{scope} AND AND ORDER BY (m.review_status = 'REVIEWED') DESC, RAND() LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM mission m WHERE m.tier = #{tier} AND ORDER BY (m.review_status = 'REVIEWED') DESC, m.variant_no LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM mission m WHERE m.mission_id = #{missionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mission (verse_no, tier, scope, site_id, variant_no, body, origin_ref, review_status) VALUES (#{verseNo}, #{tier}, #{scope}, #{siteId}, #{variantNo}, #{body}, #{originRef}, #{reviewStatus}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE body = VALUES(body), origin_ref = VALUES(origin_ref), review_status = VALUES(review_status)
